template_data.lead_html: "Does my company even qualify?" — the first question, almost every time.

rows.what_html: Two years in business, commercial revenue on record — lower than most owners expect
Clean record + active SAM.gov + a matching SIN — three things that unlock the application
Most who ask "do I qualify" — they do — the process is long, the starting line isn't

template_data.closer: THE STARTING LINE IS CLOSER THAN YOU THINK.
